page_title: NAN 1-2 PAR | Nantes v Paris FC 18/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+3' Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and produces a low shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
90+3' The ratio of the ball possession is 47:53.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Benoit Millot blows his whistle for a foul.
89' Nantes have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
89' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Nantes! Play can continue.
89' Referee Benoit Millot makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Nantes. Let’s see what happens!
89' Surely that's handball by one of the Paris FC players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
88' Nantes seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
87' We are about to witness a subsitution. Marshall Munetsi (Paris FC) for Ilan Kebbal.
85' Vincent Marchetti (Paris FC) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
83' Ahmed Kantari has decided to substitute Ibrahima Sissoko and he is replaced by Amady Camara (Nantes).
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Otavio departs the field of play to be replaced by Vincent Marchetti (Paris FC).
78' 1 - 2 Goal - 1:2! Hamari Traore laid the ball off to Luca Koleosho (Paris FC), who shot from close range into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
76' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
72' Ibrahima Sissoko (Nantes) tackles a bit over-zealously and Benoit Millot blows for a foul.
71' Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
69' Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
69' Luca Koleosho (Paris FC) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
67' Luca Koleosho (Paris FC) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
67' Paris FC seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
67' Substitution. Alimani Gory makes way for Luca Koleosho (Paris FC).
65' That will be all from Francis Coquelin who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes).
65' Ahmed Kantari has decided to make a change. Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) replaces Youssef El Arabi.
64' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) sends the corner into the box, but Anthony Lopes intercepts it and averts the threat.
63' Nhoa Sangui (Paris FC) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Good work from Paris FC as they win a corner.
63' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
62' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) is penalised for holding. Benoit Millot signals a set piece.
60' Timothee Kolodziejczak (Paris FC) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
60' Remy Cabella (Nantes) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
58' Hamari Traore (Paris FC) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
56' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Anthony Lopes intercepts the ball.
54' Junior Mwanga (Nantes) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Kevin Trapp comes off the line to clear the ball away.
53' Paris FC exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
52' Remy Cabella (Nantes) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

50' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Matthis Abline (Nantes) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the top right corner. The assist goes to Junior Mwanga and the score changes to 1:1.
47' One of the players from Nantes times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' Benoit Millot has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+6' The foul by Kelvin Amian (Nantes) was seen by Benoit Millot who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

45+4' It's unbelievable, Francis Coquelin (Nantes) blows a huge opportunity! He is totally unmarked and fires a first-time shot towards goal from a few yards out, but Kevin Trapp reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
45+1' What a big chance! Johann Lepenant (Nantes) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball well wide of the left post.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' This shall not pass! Ibrahima Sissoko (Nantes) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
42' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Nantes was in an offside position.

38' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Nantes are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
38' Alimani Gory (Paris FC) commits a foul during an attacking move.
37' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
35' Benoit Millot shows a yellow card to Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) for his blatant foul.

35' Mamadou Mbow (Paris FC) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Benoit Millot blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
33' Benoit Millot blows his whistle as Youssef El Arabi (Nantes) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
31' Junior Mwanga (Nantes) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
30' Matthis Abline (Nantes) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar.
29' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
27' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Nantes.
23' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tylel Tati (Nantes) was quite harsh and Benoit Millot didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
21' Stephane Gilli is stunned as referee Benoit Millot shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
21' Tylel Tati (Nantes) commits a rough foul. Benoit Millot stops the game and makes a call.
19' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post.
18' Substitution. Deiver Machado will be replaced by Johann Lepenant (Nantes).
17' Neat passing move from Paris FC in order to create new attacking opportunities.
15' Deiver Machado (Nantes) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
14' A pass from Matthis Abline (Nantes) is intercepted by Kevin Trapp and the move breaks down.
11' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal due to a foul. The Paris FC players look gutted.
11' The Paris FC players halt their celebrations as referee Benoit Millot makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
9' Goal Alimani Gory (Paris FC)! Alimani Gory (Paris FC) was put through by Jean-Philippe Krasso and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom right corner. 0:2.
8' Adama Camara (Paris FC) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
6' 0 - 1 GOAL! Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 0:1.
6' The resulting corner from Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
5' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.

4' Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Benoit Millot stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Paris FC are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
2' Foul! Ibrahima Sissoko (Nantes) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Paris FC will have the kick-off.
Benoit Millot is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
